records.summary: Barbora flew her baby, born abroad, to Israel on a tourist visa and registered her at Misrad Hapnim herself; MH took one day, the whole process under a month, and MH didn't make trouble about her 4 months abroad.
practices: Registers a baby born abroad as an Israeli citizen in about one day once all apostilled, translated and notarized documents are provided
Asks for pregnancy papers, birth and hospital release documents with the baby's name and date of birth, first pediatric checks, and the birth certificate
